main.description: Unsend (decision J1): redact the caller's own sender copies of these messages in a conversation's thread records. Each matching item keeps its batch, server order, messageId, timestamp, mekId and senderTransportPubkey; its signedEncMessage is removed and redactedAt is set (defs#sealedMessage). Author-only: items written by other DIDs are never touched, even under a reused messageId ([CB-31]). Every attachment reference to a redacted message is invalidated. Current membership is not required. Thread endpoint on the conversation's sequencer DS; a device homed elsewhere is relayed (labyrinthRelay). Idempotent: unknown or already-redacted ids count zero. Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge, QuotaExceeded.

redacted.description: How many stored items were redacted by this call.
